title: items
summary: Benilla defines the item wire: template query/response, use/open/auto-equip/auto-store/swap/swap-inv/split/destroy/set-ammo bodies, and the SMSG_INVENTORY_CHANGE_FAILURE + SMSG_ITEM_ENCHANT_TIME_UPDATE reads. MSUI implements the query pair, CMSG_USE_ITEM, CMSG_AUTOEQUIP_ITEM, CMSG_SWAP_ITEM, CMSG_SWAP_INV_ITEM, CMSG_SPLIT_ITEM, CMSG_SET_AMMO, and handles SMSG_ITEM_PUSH_RESULT.

openItems.text: CMSG_OPEN_ITEM: absent - lockboxes/wrapped/openable items cannot be cracked open
CMSG_DESTROYITEM (bag, slot, count): absent - items cannot be destroyed
CMSG_AUTOSTORE_BAG_ITEM: absent (bag-to-bag auto-store; MSUI only has explicit swap/split)
SMSG_INVENTORY_CHANGE_FAILURE: no handler - every refused move/equip fails silently with no red error text
SMSG_ITEM_ENCHANT_TIME_UPDATE: no handler (temporary enchant countdown updates dropped)
